property_summary: For any inputs, calling initialize on a freshly-deployed C should succeed exactly once and future calls must revert due to AlreadyInitialized; the mutant that removes the revert allows a second initialize call to succeed, violating that one-time-initialization property.
change_summary: Change the check that prevents re-initialization from reverting to instead allowing re-initialization by removing the revert on already-initialized (replace the initial if check to do nothing).
